text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is limited experience with overdosage. Acute ingestion of up to 20 g of ribavirin capsules, interferon alfa-2b ingestion of up to 120 million units, and subcutaneous doses of interferon alfa-2b up to 10 times the recommended doses have been reported. Primary effects that have been observed are increased incidence and severity of the adverse reactions related to the therapeutic use of interferon alfa-2b and ribavirin. However, hepatic enzyme abnormalities, renal failure, hemorrhage, and myocardial infarction have been reported with administration of single subcutaneous doses of interferon alfa-2b that exceed dosing recommendations. There is no specific antidote for interferon alfa-2b or RIBASPHERE overdose, and hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis are not effective for treatment of overdose of these agents.
